description: The latest street exchange rate of an emerging-market currency against the US dollar (USDT) from the EMpulse Street FX Index, or the rate on a given day: rate (mid), buy, sell, spread, 1/7/30-day changes, confidence class and a ready citation. Free access is delayed by one day; a Pro key gives the current day.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example EGP, NGN, ARS

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; default: the latest day available to your plan
date.title: Date

lang.description: Language of the citation text (ISO 639-1 code of a site language: en, ru, es, ar, tr, uz); default English
lang.title: Lang
